reviews.title: DO NOT USE THIS SERVICE
reviews.text: Drivers unprofessional , the app don’t work and no body supports and if you can communicate with some one they usually rude

reviews.title: No pickup through app
reviews.text: Drivers are not picking up rides/fares through the app, so you end up having to call the base and pay out cash. One driver asked for cash (when ordered through the app) then called the base to state that he asked for cash, due to the company taking days to pay out the drivers. This stalls service and during this holiday season, it worsened. Customers are paying this with time wasted in getting to their destinations.

reviews.title: Terrible be careful
reviews.text: Sometimes they have people sharing accounts and it’ll show you its a certain car and when the car gets there it’s a totally different person and/or car. I do not recommend for single female travelers for this reason because if something happens the company will deny it saying that the driver isn’t one of their drivers when they’re the ones using the app in an illegally marked car that’s not licensed to take people. Also the drivers show up late more then half the time and a lot of them are very rude so is the dispatcher they always have an attitude.
They left me in a unknown place excepting me to know where I was ..
